title: Counting to 100: Count by Ones and by Tens
seo_title: Kindergarten Counting to 100 Worksheets: Count by 1s and 10s, Hundred Chart
standard_text: Count to 100 by ones and by tens.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten counting to 100 worksheets: count on by 1s from any number, cross a new ten (29, 30), count by 10s with ten rods, and find missing numbers on a hundred chart. 100 picture questions with an answer key.
key_big: Count on by 1s from any number. After 9 in the ones place, start a new ten: 29, 30.
key_sub: Count by 10s: 10, 20, 30 … 100. 10 tens make one hundred.
body_html:
Count on by 1s

Each number is 1 more. You can start at any number and count on.

A new ten

After 9 in the ones place, start a new ten.

Count onNext
27, 28, 2930
57, 58, 5960
97, 98, 99100

Count by 10s

A rod has 10 cubes. Count the rods by 10s.

The hundred chart

Each row has 10 numbers. A row ends with a ten.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do
Going back after 29: 29, 20Start a new ten: 29, 30
Writing 210 after 2929, 30 (3 tens)
Counting rods by 1s: 1, 2, 3Count rods by 10s: 10, 20, 30
Skipping a numberSay each number: 46, 47, 48

faq.q: How high should a kindergartner count?
faq.a: By the end of kindergarten, children count to 100 by ones and by tens. They also start at any number, like 47, and count on: 48, 49, 50.

faq.q: Why does my child say 29, 20 or 29, 210?
faq.a: They know the pattern 1 to 9 but not what comes after 9. Show 29 on a hundred chart and point to the next row: after 9 ones comes a new ten, 30.

faq.q: How do I teach counting by 10s?
faq.a: Use bundles of 10 straws, ten rods or fingers (10 for each person). Count the bundles: 10, 20, 30. Then look at the last column of a hundred chart.

faq.q: Does my child need to read and write numbers to 100?
faq.a: Not yet. In kindergarten, children say the numbers to 100 and write numbers 0 to 20. Reading and writing larger numbers comes in Grade 1.
